# Bench

> Microbenchmarks.

- Package: `Bench` · Category: Shared utilities
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Bench")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Bench")` on the client

## `Gaxia.Bench`

- Runs: **server and client**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Shared/PerformanceBenchmark.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local Bench = Gaxia.Bench
-- or, to get its types in your own ModuleScript: local PerformanceBenchmark = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages.Shared.PerformanceBenchmark)
```

### Functions

- `Bench.Measure(label: string, fn: () -> (), iterations: number?): BenchResult`
  WHY os.clock() not tick(): os.clock is monotonic and CPU-time based with much higher resolution — essential for sub-millisecond measurements.
- `Bench.Compare(a: { label: string, fn: () -> () }, b: { label: string, fn: () -> () }, iterations: number?): CompareResult`

### Types

Exported types (use them in annotations: `local x: Module.TypeName`).

```lua
export type BenchResult = {
    label      : string,
    iterations : number,
    totalMs    : number,
    avgMs      : number,
    minMs      : number,
    maxMs      : number,
}
export type CompareResult = {
    a      : BenchResult,
    b      : BenchResult,
    faster : string,
    ratio  : number,
}
```
